strategies.name: Fused Coupling in Single Buffer
strategies.desc: Pre-computes all coupling coefficients and fuses forward/inverse coupling operations into vectorized operations before/after all-reduces, potentially batching multiple coupling stages. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but reduces local compute overhead through better memory access patterns and elimination of redundant W-1 loop iterations via vectorization.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather per Stage
strategies.desc: Replaces each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter (producing S elements per rank) followed by local coupling computation on the scattered shard, then all-gather to reconstruct the full vector. Results in 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but each operates on smaller payloads (S for RS output, W*S for AG), potentially better bandwidth utilization on interconnect.

strategies.name: Pipelined Overlapping All-Reduce Stages
strategies.desc: Splits the W*S vector into multiple independent chunks and pipelines all-reduce operations across stages, launching stage i+1 on chunk j while stage i operates on chunk j+1. Maintains 8 logical stages but increases dispatch count (8*num_chunks) while enabling overlap of communication and local coupling computation for improved latency hiding.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level All-Reduce
strategies.desc:
Exploits multi-node topology by performing intra-node all-reduce followed by inter-node all-reduce at each of the 8 stages, using node-local fast interconnects first. Results in 16 collective dispatches (8 intra-node + 8 inter-node) with smaller per-dispatch participant counts and payloads on inter-node phase, trading dispatch count for better matching to hardware topology.
